statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-93687 is reported against braces 3.0.3 and earlier; the npm registry latest release is still 3.0.3 with no patched version published. braces is a transitive dependency in the Directus production node_modules tree built into the directus-12 package consumed by this image. DHI will pin a fixed braces release via the directus package build when upstream publishes one and reassess runtime reachability for the API server deployment.

CVE-2026-93687 is reported against braces 3.0.3 and earlier; the npm registry latest release is still 3.0.3 with no patched version published. braces is a transitive dependency in the Directus production node_modules tree built into the directus-12 package consumed by this image. DHI will pin a fixed braces release via the directus package build when upstream publishes one and reassess runtime reachability for the API server deployment.

CVE-2026-93687 (uncontrolled recursion in braces) affects braces 3.0.3, which is a transitive dependency in the Trigger.dev self-hosted webapp node_modules tree. No patched braces release is published on npm yet. Tracking upstream braces and Trigger.dev for a fix release and assessing whether glob/minimatch call paths that reach braces are exercised in the self-hosted webapp runtime.

npm braces 3.0.3 is the latest release on the public registry and Scout reports no fixed version for CVE-2026-93687. The finding appears on the frontend production SPDX SBOM generated at build time; the runtime image ships only the generated static UI under /kodata/ui, not node_modules. Assessment of reachability in the published artifact continues pending an upstream braces release.

CVE-2026-93687 affects the npm braces package at 3.0.3, the latest release on the public npm registry, so no patched version is available yet. On Prometheus 3.x stable lines the component appears in the SPDX SBOM for bundled web UI static assets built from the prometheus package; the durable remediation is a dependency override in the prometheus HSP package build once upstream publishes a fix. Reachability of the vulnerable recursion path in the shipped static UI bundle is under assessment.
